queries.why: C gives a tertiary alcohol, so C is a ketone; D does not tautomerize, so D has no alpha-H: methanal. The only C5H10 alkene cleaving to a ketone + methanal is 2-methylbut-1-ene, giving butanone.
2-chloropentane from HCl: B is pent-1-ene or pent-2-ene. Peroxide HBr on pent-2-ene has no single major product, so under single_major B is pent-1-ene: anti-Markovnikov gives 1-bromopentane.
butanone + HCN has a stereocentre (Me != Et) but attack on the planar carbonyl is equal from both faces: racemic, not optically active.

queries.query: WHAT IF RETRACT not tautomerizes(D) THEN FIND ?A
queries.why: without the tautomerism fact D may be ethanal: 2-methylbut-2-ene cleaves to propanone (a ketone, tertiary alcohol) + ethanal. Two candidates remain.
